The '''Semagi sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the southwestern [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It bordered [[Dononter sector/Legends|Dononter]], [[Marzoon sector/Legends|Marzoon]], [[Tashtor sector|Tashtor]], [[Narrant sector/Legends|Narrant]] and [[Corbett sector/Legends|Corbett sectors]] in the Mid Rim. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] was the [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Watchman]] of the Semagi sector.<ref name="Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
